purpose: Make every baseline input explicit and prevent project-selected controls from being mistaken for teacher/Cao/experimental data.

LENGTH_M.note: Smoke-case domain length; not Cao Case 2 geometry.

INLET_AREA_M2.note: Mild-divergence smoke geometry; exact Cao A(x) remains source-gated.

EXIT_AREA_M2.note: Mild-divergence smoke geometry; not a source-reproduced exit area.

COMBUSTOR_HEIGHT_M.note: Rectangular-height control used to derive a self-consistent hydraulic diameter.

INLET_PRESSURE_PA.note: Does not represent Cao Case 2 Table 2-2 pressure.

INLET_TEMPERATURE_K.note: Does not represent Cao Case 2 Table 2-2 temperature.

INLET_VELOCITY_M_PER_S.note: Does not represent Cao Case 2 Table 2-2 velocity.

EQUIVALENCE_RATIO.note: The numeric value equals Cao Case 2 phi=0.2, but the geometry, inlet state, composition closure and source-spatial convention are different; this does not make the smoke case a Case 2 reproduction.

INJECTOR_X_M.note: No exact Cao/teacher source injector position is claimed for this smoke case.

MIXING_C_M.source_reference: Teacher Chapter 11 Eq.11.20 ledger; source range C_m=25-60.
MIXING_C_M.note: The allowed range is source-backed; the specific value 30 is a project choice.

INJECTION_MODE.source_reference: Teacher Chapter 11 Eq.11.19 includes parallel, normal and strut branches.
INJECTION_MODE.note: Branch existence is source-backed; selecting the parallel branch for this smoke case is project-defined.

FUEL_TEMPERATURE_K.note: Injected-fuel temperature for the smoke case; not claimed as Cao Case 2 source data.

FUEL_AXIAL_VELOCITY_M_PER_S.note: Injected-stream axial velocity for the smoke case; not claimed as Cao Case 2 source data.

WALL_HEAT_GRADIENT_J_PER_KG_PER_M.note: Set explicitly to zero because the dimensional mapping from teacher Eq.11.26 to the Eq.11.38 wall-heat input is unresolved. Zero is a scope control, not a validated adiabatic-wall claim.

CFL.source_reference: Teacher Chapter 11 Eq.11.45 spectral factor as documented by teacher_steady_solver; no undocumented dt0 is invented.

DEFAULT_DENSITY_CHANGE_TOLERANCE.note: Applied to the teacher Eq.11.46 metric; the numeric tolerance itself is not attributed to the teacher source.

GRID_LEVELS.note: Refinement ratio r=2 chosen for solution verification; not a physical engine input.

policy: A source-backed equation/range does not automatically make a selected case value source-backed. Project choices remain explicit even when they lie inside a teacher-provided admissible range.
